summary: Revised implementation plan for ExamFlow Edu. Incorporates user requested additions: 1) Dedicated Gemini AI API Key configuration with key validation, 2) Printable Exam Blueprint (Kisi-Kisi Soal) generator supporting Bloom-Anderson (C1-C6) and SOLO taxonomies with print/export styling, 3) School Profile editor with custom school logo and branding displayed on the student exam login and header.
